title: On Becoming a saying in the valley
subtitle: 努力坚持 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）
meta: 主题语境：努力坚持（人与自我·做人与做事·努力与坚持）　|　核心词汇：become　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 become 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the nurse ① became a saying in the valley twice over, and every sufferer in the ward said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the nurse ② becomes a saying in the valley year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ become a saying in the valley at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ become a saying in the valley before — a line in the report for April 1987 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Becoming a saying in the valley twice over, the nurse said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the thermometer at the far cupboard, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ become harder than it had been year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Become harder than it had been at once and never mention it again.

By 2000 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the report, and a new sufferer from the next ward ⑧ becomes harder than it had been twice over every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the cupboard, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ became a saying in the valley again when nobody else would.

⑩ To become a saying in the valley, my mother said in 2005, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the ward remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the ward forgets, somebody becomes a saying in the valley year after year again and somebody must become a saying in the valley twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 成为（一般过去式 became a saying in the valley：1993 年护士头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 成为（一般现在 becomes a saying in the valley：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 成为（不定式 to become a saying in the valley：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 成为（过去完成时 had become a saying in the valley：1987 年四月的护理记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 成为（动名词 becoming a saying in the valley 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 变得（become harder than it had been：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去变得比从前更难的局面）
G. v. 变得（become harder than it had been：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 成为（后段两处：新来的病患照例 becomes harder than it had been，而母亲又一次 became a saying in the valley）

answers.why: become 意为“成为”，1993 年护士来回两遍成为山谷里流传的一句话，那是病房里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 became。
become 意为“成为”，自那以后护士年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 becomes。
become 意为“成为”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯成为山谷里流传的一句话”，此处为不定式 to become a saying in the valley。
become 意为“成为”，护理记录里 四月 那行字说明早在 2000 年之前就有人成为过，故用过去完成时 had become。
become 意为“成为”，护士说“成为山谷里流传的一句话这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 becoming a saying in the valley 作主语。
become 意为“变得”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去变得比从前更难的局面”，should ever 之后用原形 become harder than it had been。
become 意为“变得”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻变得比从前更难的局面（become harder than it had been at once），以后再也不要提起。
become 意为“成为”，新来的病患每个夜晚都照例变得比从前更难的局面，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 becomes。
become 意为“成为”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍成为山谷里流传的一句话，用一般过去式 became 叙述。
become 意为“成为”，结尾那句是母亲 2005 年的话：要成为山谷里流传的一句话，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和病房记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 become 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1993 the nurse became a saying in the valley twice over, and nobody in the ward forgot it.
Even now the nurse becomes a saying in the valley year after year whenever the ward asks.
Becoming a saying in the valley twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever become harder than it had been year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new sufferer from the next ward becomes harder than it had been twice over every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother became a saying in the valley again, and the ward remembered that half.
